lines.text: David says his heart is steadfast, calls the harp and lyre to awake, and says he will awaken the dawn.
David will praise the LORD among the nations, because God's loving devotion extends beyond the heavens.
David prays that God's glory will cover all the earth and that God will save with His left hand.
God says from His sanctuary that He will triumph, will apportion the Valley of Jezreel, and calls Moab His washbasin.
David asks who will lead him to Edom, asks God for aid, and says God will trample their enemies.
